id.description: Unique integer identifier for this RFI reply. Use as the `{id}` path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete via the replies endpoints.

official.description: Whether this reply is an official RFI response. Official replies represent the authoritative answer to the RFI question.

answer_date.description: Timestamp when this reply was created, in ISO 8601 format.

plain_text_body.description: Plain text content of the reply, with HTML tags stripped.

created_by.description: Display name of the user who created this reply, formatted as first name, last name, and company.

created_by_id.description: Login information ID of the user who created this reply.

attachments.description: List of files attached to this reply.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this attachment.

name.description: Display name of the attached file.

url.description: URL to download the attached file.

filename.description: Duplicate of `name`. Deprecated — use `name` instead. Both fields carry the same value.

official.description: Whether this reply is an official response. Set to `true` to mark the reply as the official answer to the RFI question.
